open_failed: Could not open file or folder
recordings_hint: Latest 200 completed ZSR recordings in the current save folder, newest modified first.
recordings_empty: No completed recordings in this folder yet.
settings_locked: Stop recording to change these settings.
settings_saved_hint: Preferences are saved automatically. Apply shortcuts separately.
shortcut_listening: Press a key combination… (Esc to cancel)
shortcut_hint: Click a shortcut, then press the desired keys. Apply to save. Global shortcuts pause while capturing.
resolution_hint: Preserves proportions and adds black bars when needed. Smaller sources are upscaled to the selected resolution.
window_empty: No recordable windows found. Open an application and refresh.
window_hint: Records one window, not every window of an app. Keep it open, visible, and at a fixed size while recording. Protected content may appear blank. X11 requires wmctrl.
window_unsupported: Application-window recording is currently supported on Windows and Linux/X11. This desktop backend does not yet support it.
window_missing: The selected window is unavailable. Restore it or choose another window.
region_failed: Could not open the region selector.
region_hint: Region coordinates are pixels relative to the selected display.
region_instructions: Drag outside the frame to draw; drag inside to move; drag corners to resize.
audio_hint: Devices are detected automatically. Select the microphone you want to record.
audio_missing: Saved microphone unavailable — select a connected device
audio_error: Could not retrieve audio devices. Check permissions and refresh.
obs_runtime_hint: Folder containing libobs 32 and the ZSR OBS helper. Full packages include it.
settings_error: Settings could not be saved or loaded
wayland: Wayland recording is not implemented yet. Use an X11 session for this milestone.
close_hint: Stop and save your recording before closing ZSR.
font_missing: A Chinese system font was not found. Install a CJK font and restart ZSR.
empty: Choose a source and start recording.
unsupported: This source is unavailable in the current environment.
mac_region: Region capture on macOS is planned; select Display.
diagnostics: Diagnostics may contain device names and file paths. Review before sharing.
hardware_encoding_hint: Prefer OBS hardware encoders (AMD / NVIDIA / Intel); fall back to x264 if unavailable.
audio_tracks_hint: Separate mode: desktop on track 1, microphone on track 2. With one source enabled, only one track is saved. Players usually play one track at a time.
